description.text: Proofreaders and copy markers compare the manuscript and proof, mark text, number, and layout errors, and do return proof review. See the O*NET 43-9081 tasks, 2025 United States wages, the BLS 2025–2035 projection, the Chinese wage gap, and the fictional exercises.

subject.name: Proofreaders and copy markers
subject.summary: Proofreaders and copy markers compare the original manuscript with the typeset proof, mark errors in spelling, punctuation, grammar, numbers, layout, and omissions, verify whether changes have been implemented, and then pass items needing a decision to the author or editor. The occupation centers on finding and marking errors, while rewriting and final approval of facts rest with content editing.
